name: 💾 DATABASE (Simpan ke SQLite)
info:
Simpan semua data sensor ke database untuk historis
Tabel v2: ditambah kolom temp, hum, alert

name: 💾 Build INSERT SQL (v2)
func:
var d = msg.payload;

msg.topic = "INSERT INTO sensor_data (node, soil, hall, mag, tip, tilt, rain, temp, hum, alert, rssi, snr, timestamp) VALUES ('" 
    + d.node + "', " 
    + d.soil + ", " 
    + d.hall + ", " 
    + d.mag + ", " 
    + d.tip + ", " 
    + d.tilt + ", " 
    + (d.rain || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.temp || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.hum || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.alert || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.rssi || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.snr || 0) + ", '" 
    + d.timestamp + "')";

return msg;

name: 🚀 Startup (Buat/Update Tabel)
topic: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_data (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, node TEXT, soil INTEGER, hall INTEGER, mag INTEGER, tip INTEGER, tilt REAL, rain REAL, temp REAL DEFAULT 0, hum REAL DEFAULT 0, alert INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rssi INTEGER, snr REAL, timestamp TEXT)
